sar.narrative: Transaction 3509359 was flagged by the bank's real-time fraud detection system with a risk score of 0.52. The transaction, totaling $125.08, was conducted online on December 3, 2016. Initial investigation noted a discrepancy between the purchaser's email domain (yahoo.com) and the recipient's email domain (cox.net). Due to the ambiguous nature of the risk score, a Tier 2 agent initiated a step-up authentication process to validate the activity. The customer, identified as C12265, was contacted and explicitly stated they did not authorize the transaction. The customer also confirmed they were still in possession of their card, suggesting a card-not-present data compromise. No previous legitimate history with the merchant or recipient 'cox.net' was found for this account. The activity is classified as Card Not Present fraud. The card C12265-K2 has been deactivated to prevent further unauthorized use. Total exposure is limited to the single flagged transaction of $125.08. This SAR is filed to document the confirmed unauthorized access and attempted theft of funds.
